reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports that ΔG_bcc-fcc governs deformation-induced fcc-to-bcc transformation and that phase fractions correlate with thermodynamic stability in similar alloys, but it does not address the proposed BCC-to-FCC transformation in Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7, nor does it provide evidence for the claimed kinetic modulation by sluggish diffusion.
premises: Gibbs free energy difference (ΔG_bcc-fcc) drives phase transformation in Cr-Co-Fe-Ni-Al alloys
Deformation-induced martensitic transformation is affected by ΔG_bcc-fcc
Phase fraction after transformation correlates with thermodynamic phase stability
Kinetic effects (sluggish diffusion) modulate the rate of transformation
